description: Shobayo, Peter and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. TheCSV collection describes road, rail and inland-waterway container flows for the Rhine section of the Rhine-Alpine corridor at NUTS2 level. Coverage includes cost, time and emissions estimates plus accessibility, frequency and availability of transport modes, as stated in the native title. The description explicitly links the data to the Weighted Logit Mixture study of heterogeneous shipper preferences. These are model inputs, not shipment-level confidential microdata. Observation years, estimated-variable uncertainty and unit definitions are not available in the brief metadata. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The collection supplies inputs for the published freight mode-choice model.
